signposting.archaic: Translation published before 1850 - expect dated, difficult English
signposting.identical: Public domain. The free text is the same text.
signposting.none: In copyright. Students need a licensed copy.
signposting.older: Translation from 1850-1899 - readable, but not modern English
signposting.rule: A translation flag is NEVER applied to a work written in English, however old; there the old English is the text.
signposting.similar: Free version available in a different translation or edition.
